Thanks Anna — quick internal note to loop procurement & finance.

Short answer: Redwood policy requires a purchase order (PO) for vendor invoices above $1,000 unless a formal exception is granted. That said, procurement can approve a temporary, tightly-scoped exception for pilot engagements if controls are in place (onboarding form, tax docs, GL coding, and a clearly capped spend).

Marissa — can you do two things?
1) Confirm the SOW amount and send the Gingercity proposal/SOW to procurement so they can generate a one-time PO (if we go that route).
2) If Gingercity prefers invoice-first, propose the exact invoice cadence and we’ll try to get a conditional exception approved with procurement.

Looping: Logan (procurement) and Naomi (finance) for policy + approvals.
